Interface Transport

All Known Implementing Classes:
RmiTransport, TcpTransport
public interface Transport
Abstracts the network transport layer from the view (TUI / GUI).

Implementations handle the connection lifecycle and message exchange for a specific technology (TCP object serialization or RMI). The view only calls connect(String, int, String, Supplier, Function), send(ClientMessage), and setOnMessage(Consumer) — it has no knowledge of sockets, streams, or RMI stubs.

Lifecycle:

  1. Call setOnMessage(Consumer) to register the inbound message handler.
  2. Call connect(String, int, String, Supplier, Function) to open the connection and send the login.
  3. Call send(ClientMessage) for each outbound ClientMessage.
  4. Call close() when the session ends.

  • Method Details

    • connect

      void connect(String host, int port, String nick, Supplier<Integer> askNumPlayers, Function<List<TotemColor>, TotemColor> askColor) throws Exception
      Opens the connection to the server and performs the lobby handshake.

      The transport sends the initial login, reads the server response, and invokes askNumPlayers only if the server replies LOBBY_FIRST (i.e. this is the first connecting client). Subsequent clients receive LOBBY_JOINED and the supplier is never called.

      Parameters:
      host - server hostname or IP address
      port - server port (TCP: 1234 default, RMI: 1099 default)
      nick - player nickname
      askNumPlayers - called only when this client must set the player count; must return a value in [2, 5]
      askColor - called after lobby join with the list of available colors; must return the chosen TotemColor (or null for auto-assign)
      Throws:
      Exception - if the connection or login fails (e.g. NICKNAME_TAKEN)

    • send

      void send(ClientMessage msg) throws Exception
      Sends a ClientMessage to the server.
      Parameters:
      msg - the message to send
      Throws:
      Exception - if the send fails

    • setOnMessage

      void setOnMessage(Consumer<ServerMessage> listener)
      Registers the handler invoked for every ServerMessage received from the server. Must be called before connect(String, int, String, Supplier, Function).
      Parameters:
      listener - called on the transport's reader thread (TCP) or on the RMI callback thread — implementations must be thread-safe with respect to the view's rendering logic

    • close

      void close()
      Closes the connection and releases any resources. Safe to call more than once.
